title: CareLevo pairing/connection fails on Android OS 13
symptom: Pairing/connection does not complete properly on Android OS 13. The same connection flow appears to work normally on Android 14 and above.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state a root cause, but the fix commit and additional changes suggest that the issue was related to isBonded handling and Android OS 13 specific behavior.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit (94db69e76baac2d4f7fddf6a730b1ef6fe7befdd) and additional changes including Android OS 13 handling and scan selection updates were merged.
